article.title: A Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating Digital Health Intervention on Phosphate Control in Patients on Dialysis.
article.authors: Beer J, Jacques A, Lambert K
article.abstract: Hyperphosphataemia is a common metabolic complication of CKD and is associated with poor health outcomes. Dietary intervention is a key strategy in its management; however, it is complicated by the complexity of the diet and limited access to dietitians. This study evaluated whether a digital health intervention delivering dietary advice alongside standard care was effective in reducing serum phosphate. The present analysis reports the trial's primary outcome.
